title.fr: Le Centre du Canada et le Québec

text.en: Southern Quebec and southern Ontario are called Central Canada. They are the industrial and manufacturing heart of the country.
text.fr: Le sud du Québec et le sud de l'Ontario forment ce qu'on appelle le Centre du Canada. C'est le cœur industriel et manufacturier du pays.

source.quote: known as Central Canada and the industrial and manufacturing heartland

verification.evidence: CENTRAL CANADA More than half the people in Canada live in cities and towns near the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River in southern Quebec and Ontario, known as Central Canada and the industrial and manufacturing heartland.

text.en: Almost all the people of Quebec live on or close to the St. Lawrence River.
text.fr: La très grande majorité des habitants du Québec vivent le long du fleuve Saint-Laurent ou tout près.

source.quote: the vast majority along or near the St. Lawrence River

verification.evidence: Quebec Nearly eight million people live in Quebec, the vast majority along or near the St. Lawrence River.

text.en: What the Canadian Shield holds has helped Quebec build up important industries: mining, energy and forestry.
text.fr: Les richesses du Bouclier canadien ont aidé le Québec à bâtir d'importantes industries : les mines, l'énergie et la forêt.

source.quote: The resources of the Canadian Shield have helped Quebec to develop important industries, including forestry, energy and mining.

verification.evidence: The resources of the Canadian Shield have helped Quebec to develop important industries, including forestry, energy and mining. Quebec is Canada’s main producer of pulp and paper.

text.en: Montreal is the second largest city in Canada.
text.fr: Montréal est la deuxième ville en importance au Canada.

verification.evidence: Montreal, Canada’s second largest city and the second largest mainly French-speaking city in the world after Paris, is famous for its cultural diversity.

text.en: Among the cities of the world where most people speak French, Montreal is second in size. Only Paris is larger.
text.fr: Parmi les villes du monde où la population parle surtout français, Montréal vient au deuxième rang. Seul Paris est plus grand.

source.quote: the second largest mainly French-speaking city in the world after Paris

verification.evidence: Montreal, Canada’s second largest city and the second largest mainly French-speaking city in the world after Paris, is famous for its cultural diversity.

text.en: Montreal is well known for the many cultures of its people.
text.fr: Montréal est bien connue pour la diversité culturelle de sa population.

source.quote: is famous for its cultural diversity

verification.evidence: Montreal, Canada’s second largest city and the second largest mainly French-speaking city in the world after Paris, is famous for its cultural diversity.
